name: Conductor
description: Interactive orchestral conducting experience in the browser

history.summary: Native Webcam Aspect Ratio & Direct SVG-Space Coordinate Alignment
details: Native Webcam Aspect Ratio: Removed all hardcoded aspect-ratio locks so the video and overlay canvas naturally adopt the camera's exact native resolution (4:3, 16:9, etc.) without distortion

Direct SVG-Space Coordinate Calculation: Measured laser ray origin directly against the stage SVG overlay bounding rect with aspect-scaled directional vectors, guaranteeing exact alignment with the on-screen fingertip dot

history.summary: 1-to-1 Pixel-Perfect Fingertip Laser Origin & Pure Straight Beam (No Snapping)
details: 1-to-1 Pixel-Perfect Fingertip Origin: Switched camera media wrap to dynamic aspect-ratio matching (16:9) with object-fit: fill, aligning the laser ray start point with sub-pixel precision directly at the conductor's index fingertip

Pure Straight Laser Beam: Removed magnetic snapping to section centers — the laser ray now stays 100% straight and moves freely with your finger angle, triggering the spotlight and impact spark only when the beam actively intersects an instrument section

history.summary: Free Ray-Cast Targeting, Instant Gestural Start, Auto Keyboard Fallback & Fixed Sweet-Spot Gauge
details: True Fingertip Ray-Casting & Free Aim: Fixed mirrored screen coordinates so the laser shoots directly from the conductor's physical fingertip. The laser ray now moves freely anywhere across the stage and selectively spotlights an instrument only when the beam actively intersects it
Instant Hands-Raised Gestural Start: Raising hands on camera now immediately starts the orchestra playback in Mode E (Expressive) without long delays or waiting for multiple beat taps
Camera Error Fallback to Keyboard: If camera permission is denied, a webcam is not detected, or MediaPipe fails to load, Conductor gracefully and automatically falls back to Keyboard mode

Anchored Target Sweet-Spot BPM Band: Fixed the green target zone on the tempo gauge to remain static at the piece's nominal intended tempo (e.g. 140 BPM for Mozart), while your current tempo indicator pill moves freely up and down

history.summary: Angled Stage Laser Ray, Video Compositing Bypass & Halved Background Reduction
details: Full-Stage Angled Laser Ray: An ultra-fast SVG laser ray shoots in real-time from the conductor's pointing index fingertip, angling across the camera frame border and connecting directly to the targeted orchestra instruments above

Video Compositing Bypass in Spotlight Mode: Hides the webcam video texture completely in focus mode so glowing hands float on a dark celestial stage, eliminating video composite overhead for maximum framerate
GPU-Accelerated Party & Love Modes: Replaced expensive 100vw multi-radial-gradient repaints with GPU hue-rotate & opacity transforms, eliminating stutters in Party Mode (✌️✌️) and Love Mode (🤟)
Halved Background Instrument Fading: Softened the background reduction by 50% — non-spotlighted instruments remain musical and clearly audible at 0.72x (-2.8dB) and visually bright at 0.55 opacity

history.summary: Spotlight Refinements: Vertical Hand Angle Gating, 60fps GPU Performance & Layout Polish
details: Strict Hand Angle & Verticality Gating: Hand orientation must be substantially vertical with index finger pointing straight up, eliminating false trigger from sideways/tilted hands and dynamics conducting
Tighter Finger Curling Threshold: Middle, ring, and pinky fingers must be substantially curled into the palm, preventing loose or relaxed conducting hands from triggering spotlight mode
Buttery Smooth 60fps Framerate: Removed expensive Canvas 2D CPU software shadowBlur passes and multi-pass nested SVG CSS drop-shadow filters, moving to GPU-accelerated gradient layering

Layout & Boundary Polish: Removed redundant conductor illustration ('egg with chopsticks') to reclaim vertical screen space, elevated orchestra silhouette with z-index 40 to prevent camera frame collisions, and repositioned top banner

history.summary: Spotlight Mode & Spatial Stereo DSP: Pointing Spotlight, Above-Camera Seating, Center Stage Pull & Stereo Dispersal
details: Above-Camera Seating Layout: Instrument sections now reside naturally above the webcam view by default, smoothly gliding downward into direct reach when Spotlight Mode is activated

Direct Pointing Spotlight: Replaced multi-step pinch gesture with instant, fluid Pointing Spotlight — pointing at any section immediately spotlights it forward into forte (f) tier while backgrounding other sections in piano (p)
Natural Stereo Spatial Panorama: Each orchestral section is panned across the stereo field corresponding directly to its UI seating arrangement (Violin I on the left through Cello/Bass on the right)

Center Stage Focus Pull & Dispersal: When an instrument is spotlighted, its spatial pan glides smoothly to center stage with intimate dry presence while the rest of the orchestra disperses outward to the stereo sides
Quick & Forgiving Dynamic Recovery: Releasing the pointing gesture smoothly restores natural ensemble balance and spatial seating over 200–350ms

history.summary: Camera Instrument Focus Mode: Select & Bring Orchestral Sections Forward with Gestures
details: Pointing Gesture Focus Mode: Holding a Pointing Up (☝️) gesture fades the webcam down while keeping glowing hands vivid, smoothly elevating the orchestra section UI above the camera view
Generous Fingertip Hover: Index fingertip serves as an intuitive pointer with forgiving hit targets and anti-flicker debouncing
Pinch to Grab: Bringing index fingertip and thumb together (scale-normalized distance) grabs and locks onto the hovered instrument section
Two-Hand Continuous Focus Modulation: Spreading hands apart pulls the selected section forward in the mix (+2.6dB) while gently backgrounding other sections (-7dB) with smooth acoustic transitions
Conflict-Free Conducting: Camera beats and global dynamics are cleanly isolated during focus manipulation and restored seamlessly upon release

history.summary: Feature-Flagged Thumbs-Up VFX Burst with Debug Toggle Checkbox
details: Feature Flagged OFF by Default: Thumbs-Up particle starburst VFX is deactivated by default for standard performance purity
Debug Diagnostic Checkbox: Added a toggle checkbox in the D (Debug) diagnostic menu ('✨ Thumbs Up Camera VFX Burst') to easily test and demonstrate the celestial particle effect on demand
Zero Performance Overhead: Particle loops and gesture listeners are completely bypassed when the flag is disabled

history.summary: Magical Thumbs-Up Canvas Particle & Shockwave VFX Burst
details: Pure Visual Thumbs-Up Magic: Pointing thumb upward triggers a sparkling celestial VFX burst on the camera feed with zero intrusive text or transport interruptions
Celestial Particle System: Emits 16 shimmering diamond-star particles in golden, champagne, cyan, and star-white hues that radiate outwards with dynamic rotation and decay
Dual Shockwave Rings & Border Glow: Renders expanding radiant gold energy rings and a golden preview container halo upon detection

history.summary: Party Mode Refinement: Pure Visual Disco Effect Active Exclusively While Holding Double Peace Sign
details: Uncoupled Dynamics from Party Mode: Preserved authentic conductor volume and dynamics without overriding or forcing fortissimo (fff), eliminating dynamic glitches
Synchronous Gesture Engagement: Party Mode visual disco lighting and banner remain active strictly while both peace signs are held, cleanly disengaging the moment hands change
Streamlined 'Party Mode' Banner: Simplified the celebratory banner text to a clean, focused 'Party Mode' banner

history.summary: Gesture Streamlining: Thumbs Down Cutoff & Double Peace Party Mode Exclusively Active
details: Focused Intentional Gestures: Retained the two most reliable and distinct conducting gestures: Thumbs Down (👎) for dramatic cutoff/pause and Double Peace Signs (✌️✌️) for Party Mode & tutti fortissimo (fff)
Suspended Accidental Triggers: Deactivated ILoveYou and Thumbs Up (Fermata) triggers to guarantee 100% false-positive-free rehearsal and conducting stability
Streamlined Stage Hints: Updated stage contextual prompts to clearly guide conductors on Thumbs Down and Double Peace Sign controls

history.summary: Gesture Remapping: Thumbs-Down Cutoff, Thumbs-Up Fermata, and 'ILoveYou' (🤟) Love Mode (Pink Screen, pp & Max Reverb)
details: Thumbs Down (👎) Dramatic Cutoff: Pointing thumb downward cleanly executes a dramatic orchestral pause/cutoff without false triggers; releasing the thumb instantly resumes playback
Thumbs Up (👍) Fermata: Pointing thumb upward enters a musical Fermata (𝄐), freezing the score transport to sustain the current chord with zero accidental activations during normal baton motion

ILoveYou (🤟) Love Mode: Forming the love gesture (thumb, index, pinky extended) transforms the stage into an ethereal romantic dreamscape with a glowing pink aura, whisper pianissimo (pp) dynamics, and max concert hall reverb bloom (0.75 wet mix)
Toggled Off Closed Fist & Open Palm Actions: Deactivated cutoff/fermata from fists and open palms so natural conducting hand shapes never trigger unexpected pauses or holds
Double Peace Signs (✌️✌️): Retained celebratory Party Mode disco lighting with maximum tutti fortissimo (fff)

history.summary: Gesture-Driven Expressive Conducting: Dramatic Fist Cutoff & Resume, 5-Finger Open Palm Fermata Note Hold, and Double Peace Sign Party Mode & Tutti Fortissimo
details: Dramatic Fist Cutoff & Auto-Resume: Forming a closed fist instantly triggers a dramatic orchestral pause/cutoff; reopening your fist seamlessly resumes piece playback right from where it paused

5-Finger Open Palm Fermata: Holding up an open hand with all 5 fingers spread enters a musical Fermata (𝄐), freezing the score transport to sustain and hold the current note/chord until the gesture is released
Double Peace Signs Party Mode (✌️✌️): Flashing peace signs on both hands activates Party Mode with vibrant animated rainbow disco stage lighting and instant tutti fortissimo (fff) orchestral power
Live Expressive Gesture Banners: High-contrast stage overlays and camera canvas badges provide real-time visual feedback for Fist Cutoffs, Fermatas, and Party Mode celebrations

history.summary: Full-Height Video-Aligned Tempo Speedometer, Single Translucent Conductor Needle, Debug Orchestra Toggle & Streamlined Dynamics Ribbon
details: Full Video-Height Tempo Speedometer: Expanded the vertical tempo gauge to span the full height of the webcam feed (616px), giving the 40-220 BPM track an expansive, luxury cockpit aesthetic
Single Translucent Conductor (YOU) Needle: Replaced dual overlapping indicators with a unified, frosted-glass translucent gold pill that glides cleanly along the vertical gauge without text clutter
Debug Orchestra Speed Toggle: Orchestra playback speed beacon is now toggleable in the D (Debug) diagnostic HUD, keeping the performance stage uncluttered
Streamlined Dynamics Ribbon: Removed outdated helper text from the dynamic ribbon for a cleaner, modern stage interface

history.summary: Gesture-Aligned UI Reorientation (Horizontal Dynamics Ribbon & Vertical Tempo Speedometer), Classic Gestures Default & Intuitive Keyboard Controls
details: Gesture-Aligned UI Orientation: Redrew UI components so visual layouts map 1:1 to conducting gestures — Horizontal Dynamics Ribbon spans below the camera (matching hand width spread) and Vertical Tempo Speedometer climbs beside the camera (matching hand height)

Classic Gesture Mapping as Default: Two-hand horizontal width controls orchestral dynamics (pp to fff) while vertical hand height controls conducting tempo (0.35x to 1.65x piece BPM), with the experimental flipped option housed cleanly in the D (Debug) HUD
Intuitive Expressive Keyboard Controls: Swapped arrow keys to match visual orientation — ↑ / ↓ adjust Target Tempo and ← / → adjust Orchestral Dynamics

history.summary: Flipped Camera Axis Gestures (Width: Tempo / Height: Volume Default), Camera Axes Feature Toggle & 4-Beat Keyboard Inactivity Grace
details: Flipped Camera Gestures (Default): Spreading hands horizontally (Width ↔) now intuitively controls Tempo (Accelerando / Rallentando), while raising and lowering hands (Height ↕) controls Volume / Dynamics (pp to fff)
Interactive Axes Feature Toggle: Switch effortlessly between '↔ Width: Tempo | ↕ Height: Volume' (Flipped) and '↕ Height: Tempo | ↔ Width: Volume' (Classic) via UI pill or press X key
4-Beat Keyboard Inactivity Grace: Increased Keyboard Beat Mode inactivity cutoff from 2 to 4 beats, giving conductors room for expressive pauses and rubato without unintended stopping

history.summary: Hand-Scale Adaptive Camera Dynamics (P/PP Close-Up), Instant Keyboard Inactivity Halt & 1-Beat Lead-In Audio Timing
details: Hand-Scale Adaptive Camera Dynamics: Computes physical hand size and inner edge-to-edge gap from all 21 hand landmarks, ensuring bringing hands together reliably reaches pp and p dynamics regardless of camera distance or hand scale
Prompt Keyboard Inactivity Halt: In Keyboard Beat Mode, playback pauses promptly within 2 missed beat pulses as soon as the conductor stops tapping

1-Beat Lead-In Audio Scheduling: Two preparatory taps establish the pulse (Beat 1, Beat 2), and the orchestra enters on Beat 3 with a full beat lookahead window, guaranteeing 100% audio attack fidelity on opening notes

history.summary: Fix Keyboard Beat Mode Speed Sync, Immediate Audio Playback on Downbeat & Spacebar Start in Expressive Mode
details: Keyboard Beat Mode Speed & Audio Fix: Synchronized beatsPerTap across score transport, clock state, and instant BPM estimator in Keyboard mode so tapping matches score tempo 1:1 (eliminating the half-speed mismatch) and audio plays immediately on the 2nd tap
Spacebar Playback Trigger in Expressive Mode: Pressing SPACE now immediately launches/resumes playback in Expressive Mode (in addition to P)
Downbeat Instant Playback: Opening downbeat notes now trigger immediately upon the establishing tap without artificial latency

history.summary: Keyboard Mode Enhancements, Emerald Green Ambient Dynamics, High-Contrast Stage Action Buttons & Spacious Orchestra Layout
details: Keyboard Mode & Explicit 1-Beat Tapping: Input mode renamed to 'Keyboard'. In Keyboard Mode, taps always advance 1 quarter-note beat per tap (1 tap = 1 beat), while cut-time doubling (1 stroke = 2 beats) is exclusively reserved for Camera hand conducting

Dynamic Contextual Controls Explanations: Hint bars now dynamically explain the controls for all combinations of Keyboard/Camera and Expressive/Beat modes (including ↑/↓ for volume, ←/→ for target tempo accelerando/rallentando, and SPACE for beats)
Emerald/Forest Green Ambient Dynamics Ambiance: The stage background lighting now smoothly glows emerald green during mf and mp, complementing the deep blue at pp/p and fiery crimson at ff/fff
High-Contrast Stage Action Buttons: 'Restart from Top' and 'Switch Piece' buttons restyled in vibrant gold/glass accents and remain permanently accessible during rehearsal and performance
Spacious Orchestra Stage Layout: Expanded orchestra stage to 1000px width with 140px pitch between all 7 Beethoven 5th sections, eliminating all instrument and label overlapping

history.summary: Cut Time Mode D Tempo Doubling, Simplified Two-Mode UI (Expressive & Beat), and In-Tempo Autoplay Debug Integration
details: Cut Time Tempo Display: Mode D ('Beat' Mode) accurately reflects cut time conducting (1 stroke = 2 beats). Both the Tempo Speedometer readout and internal clock now double the pulse rate to display true quarter-note score BPM (e.g. 140 BPM instead of 70 BPM)

Simplified Two-Mode Stage UI: Streamlined main stage tempo controls down to two clear, expressive modes: '🪄 Expressive' (Mode E continuous gestural conducting, default) and '🥁 Beat' (Mode D cut-time conducting)
Contextual Mode Hint Texts: Informative dynamic hints below the mode selector instruct users on exactly how to use each mode in real time
Debug Panel Autoplay Integration: Modes A (Balanced PLL), B (Instant), and C (In-Tempo Autoplay) moved to the Diagnostics & Debug Overlay (D key), including a one-click 'Play Song in Tempo' button
BPM Green Zone in All Modes: The ±20 BPM target band on the tempo gauge is now active across modes to guide tempo steering

history.summary: Fix Camera Auto-Start on Initial Load, Center Hero Camera Layout & Continuous Analogue Dynamics Scale
details: Camera Auto-Start: Camera now initializes and starts tracking automatically on initial page load without requiring the user to toggle away and back
Centered Hero Camera Layout: Camera video feed and skeleton overlay mounted directly into center hero slot in main performance stage
Analogue Continuous Dynamics Marker: Vertical sliding marker track alongside discrete pp-fff ladder providing real-time analogue hand aperture feedback
Natural Hand Neutral Calibration: Neutral tempo center aligned to 40% height (hands resting comfortably in front of chest) matching natural webcam framing

history.summary: Mode E (Gestural Conducting): Continuous Accelerando, Hands-Up Auto-Start, Finger Beating, Interpolated Dynamics, Lead-In Beat, Cursor Key Tempo Nudge, BPM Green Zone
details: Mode E — Gestural Conducting: Raising hands starts the orchestra; dropping them off-screen stops it within 2 beats. Low hands = rallentando (Largo reachable at y=0.10), raised hands = accelerando (up to 1.65× base BPM)
Finger Beating: When one hand is steady and the other is actively beating time, only the steady hand governs tempo — the beating hand does not modulate accelerando

Interpolated Continuous Dynamics: Hand separation now feeds a 0–1 continuous value into AudioEngine, smoothly interpolating LPF cutoff, high-shelf gain, reverb wet, and velocity multiplier between the 7 preset breakpoints (pp to fff) with no discrete step
Beethoven 5 Lead-In Beat: One silent beat of anticipation before the orchestra plays its first note, timed precisely to the established conducting tempo
Cursor Key Tempo Nudge (Mode E): ← / → keys shift the base BPM ±5 BPM; \ always triggers accent in all modes
BPM Green Zone: Soft translucent green band on the tempo speedometer gauge shows ±20 BPM around the piece's intended BPM in Mode E
Hands-Down Threshold Fix: Mode E only pauses when hands are fully off-screen, not just held low — allows conducting at Largo speed without accidentally pausing
Beat Sound Off by Default: Instant cymbal cue now defaults to off; VFX beat flash still fires. Toggle in Debug Overlay (D key)
Clock Mode D (Inertial): Simplified to coast indefinitely at established tempo, clear history after gaps, gentle phase re-anchor on resume — no more tempo drift from long inter-beat intervals
Mode D / Mode E Hands-Down Pause: Pauses after 6 beats of fully-absent hands in Mode D, 2 beats in Mode E

history.summary: Bidirectional Beat Detection (Bottom Trough & Top Apex), Default Instant Cymbal Cue, Camera Kinematics Log & Dual-Marker Horizontal BPM Speedometer
details: Bidirectional Kinematic Beat Detection: Triggers crisp beats at BOTH bottom trough turnarounds (downbeat) AND top apex turnarounds (upbeat), enabling continuous 2-beats-per-cycle conducting like a real baton
Directional Color Ripples: Camera preview renders gold halo bursts for downbeats (bottom trough) and cyan halo bursts for upbeats (top apex)
Default Instant Cymbal Cue: Initialized 'Make Sound on Beat' to active on startup with instant zero-latency synthesized percussion cue
Real-Time Camera Kinematics & Beat Event Log: Live telemetry of hand elevation (Y), velocity (Vy), FSM motion state, and a rolling 6-beat history log in Debug Overlay (D key)

Horizontal BPM Speedometer Gauge: Rich glassmorphism gauge showing Conductor Indicated BPM (gold needle) vs Orchestra Playback BPM (cyan beacon) across musical tempo zones (Largo, Andante, Moderato, Allegro, Presto)
Zero-Lag Dispatch: Immediate synchronous candidate fusion and beat delivery to ConductorClock and AudioEngine

history.summary: Stage B (Phases C1 & C2): Camera Beat Detection, Clock Mode D (Inertial Cruise Control / Steer & Release), and Switchable Two-Hand Dynamics Modes
details: Permissive Hand Beat Detection: Real-time kinematic ictus detection from downward stroke velocity and bottom inflection reversal points
Two-Hand Beat Fusion & Jitter Rejection: Merges dual-hand beats within ~75ms into a single confident beat (C=1.0) and rejects stationary resting tremors
Visual Beat Feedback: Expanding golden ripple halo bursts rendered on camera preview skeleton upon each detected ictus
Clock Mode D (Inertial Cruise / Steer & Release): Flywheel inertia carries tempo for up to 16 bars without stopping; multi-beat re-entry calculation enables seamless steering and releasing
Auto-Default to Mode D: Switching to Camera Mode (C key) automatically engages Mode D, with hotkeys 1–4 and T cycling between all 4 modes
Switchable Camera Dynamics Modes: Mode 1 (Spread/Aperture: horizontal expanding/contracting from pp to fff) vs Mode 2 (Vertical Height: raising/lowering)
Ergonomic Symmetrical Calibration: Neutral shoulder-width (0.34) at mf, contracted chest-width (<0.21) for pp/p, wide arms (>0.53) for fff
Top-Left Docked Camera UI: Camera preview and dynamic ladder positioned side-by-side with 'loading magic finger detecting coolness!' loading status

history.summary: Stage A (Phase C0): Camera Plumbing, Browser-Local Hand Tracking (MediaPipe), Live Hand Skeleton & Conducting Point Overlay, Dual-Hand Tracking, and Input Source Switching
details: Added opt-in Camera Input Source alongside Keyboard (Space Bar) with seamless C-key hotkey switching
Integrated Google MediaPipe HandLandmarker (@mediapipe/tasks-vision) running 100% locally in the browser with zero backend requirements
Tracks up to 2 hands simultaneously with normalized 3D landmarks, confidence tracking, and handedness identification
Implemented conductor-space coordinate mapping (Y: 0=low to 1=high) and primary conducting point extraction (wrist vs index tip)
Added floating, collapsible Camera Preview window with glowing gold 21-joint skeleton canvas overlay and live telemetry HUD (FPS, latency, detected hands)
Engineered leak-free camera lifecycle: instant media stream release and requestAnimationFrame cancellation on mode switch

history.summary: Hybrid Dynamic Modeling: Proportional Velocity Scaling, Real-time Timbre Filtering (LPF/Shelf), Dynamic Reverb Bloom, Vertical Musical Dynamic Ladder & A/B DSP Toggles
details: Proportional MIDI velocity scaling preserves relative melody vs accompaniment phrasing across all dynamic tiers without clipping
Real-time native Web Audio DSP: Dynamic Low-Pass & High-Shelf filtering for authentic timbral brightness in forte and warmth in piano
Dynamic Concert Hall Reverb: scales acoustic hall bloom from intimate dry (7%) in pp to grand resonance (30%) in ff
Replaced heavy master compressor with transparent safety peak limiter (-1.0 dBFS) to preserve 100% natural score dynamic range
Added Vertical Musical Dynamic Ladder (pp, p, mp, mf, f, ff ⚡) with arrow keys, mouse wheel, and ff overburn decay
Added live dynamics telemetry and interactive A/B DSP component bypass toggles in the Debug Overlay (D key)
Documented sound rendering architecture in docs/SOUND_RENDERING_DESIGN.md

history.summary: Fix lost opening notes, fix tap lockout after gaps, add Cut Time (in 2) for Beethoven 5, and colocate song metadata in public/midi/
details: Fixed lost opening notes on start by clamping near-past opening events so initial downbeats never drop under tap jitter
Fixed tap lockout bug ('goes on without you') by resetting clock tap baseline on slow gaps so subsequent taps immediately regain control
Added Cut Time / Alla Breve conducting mode: Beethoven 5 conducts at 1 tap = 2 beats (~108 half notes/min instead of 216+ quarter notes)
Moved song metadata alongside .mid files in public/midi/ (Eine-Kleine-Nachtmusik1.json, 5th-Symphony-Part-1.json, and repertoire.json)
Restored natural expressive MIDI velocity dynamics while keeping master DynamicsCompressorNode

history.summary: Default 60% Dynamics, Sforzando Overboost to 120% with Surge Decay, and Score Dynamic Range Compression
details: Default dynamics initialized to 60% on start
Added Sforzando / Overboost zone (100% to 120%) with glowing fiery visual feedback
Added automatic surge decay: overboosts above 100% hold for 1.2s then gently settle back to 100%
Master DynamicsCompressorNode added so the conductor's volume wheel has absolute commanding authority

history.summary: Master Dynamics & Volume Controller (Scroll Wheel & Keyboard Arrows)
details: Added Master Dynamics volume control mapped to the mouse scroll wheel
Added keyboard shortcuts (ArrowUp / ArrowDown) and click/drag on dynamics bar
Added visual Master Dynamics HUD with live percentage display on stage
Integrated master volume scaling directly with the concert hall master bus

history.summary: Repertoire Selection (Mozart & Beethoven 5), Phase 2 (Concert Hall Reverb, pitch-collision truncation) & Phase 3 (Repertoire system & completion flow)
details: Added Repertoire catalog supporting switching between Mozart (Eine Kleine Nachtmusik) and Beethoven (Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67)
Added Repertoire selection modal with artwork, piece details, and seamless piece loading

Added dynamic orchestral stage layouts: Chamber Strings (4 sections) for Mozart vs. Full Grand Symphony (7 sections: Winds, Reeds, Horns, Trumpets, Timpani, Upper Strings, Lower Strings) for Beethoven 5
Phase 2 Concert Hall Reverb: Added stereo impulse concert hall acoustics bus and exponential velocity dynamics
Fixed accelerando note overlap: added pitch-collision voice truncation so held notes release cleanly when speeding up
Phase 3 Completion Flow: Added score completion detection with grand finale hold and replay/switch piece controls
Added SoundFonts for Bassoon, Timpani, and full orchestral instrumentation

history.summary: A/B Tempo Modes: Mode A (Balanced PLL) vs Mode B (Instant / On a Dime)
details: Added Mode A (Balanced PLL): smoothed inertia over 3-4 beats, absorbing human finger jitter
Added Mode B (Instant / On a Dime): super-responsive direct 2-gap follower for instantaneous tempo jumps
Added interactive stage pill selector for live A/B switching during conducting
Added keyboard shortcut 'T' to toggle between Mode A and Mode B in real time
Updated DebugOverlay with active tempo mode indicator

history.summary: Live visual instrument orchestra (eggs per MIDI track) & dynamic sustained note holding across tempo changes
details: Mapped SVG musician 'eggs' to distinct orchestra sections (Violin I, Violin II, Viola, Cello) with section labels
Animated live note playing reactions: musicians and sections light up with a warm radiant glow when notes on their track play
Fixed sustained notes cutting off during tempo changes by decoupling voice GainNodes from static durations
Supported rubato / held notes: voices sustain indefinitely until their true score beat arrives, allowing expressively slow or fast tempo changes
Added baton swing animation to conductor podium in rhythm with conducted pulse

history.summary: Resume from paused beat, true note duration scheduling, phase-locked transport, soundfont preloading, version modal
details: Enabled resume from current score beat after pausing (two preparatory taps resume from where left off)
Fixed note-off scheduling by passing beat-accurate duration to WebAudioFont wave tables
Preloaded WebAudioFont instrument banks during initial loading screen
Added phase-correction synchronization to ScoreTransport to prevent conductor-orchestra phase drift
Added stopAllNotes() to AudioEngine to silence voices cleanly on pause/stop
Created versioning system and interactive version info modal

history.summary: Initial Phase 0 & Phase 1 release
details: Phase 0: PLL-inspired ConductorClock and KeyboardBeatInput with synthetic tap acceptance test suite
Phase 1: MIDI score parsing into beat space (Eine Kleine Nachtmusik), look-ahead Scheduler, WebAudioFont AudioEngine, stage visual and DebugOverlay
